title: Frog dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2a7a4a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- back leg (left, kicked out) -->
  <path d='M32 78 Q18 74 12 62 Q10 56 16 56 Q22 56 24 62 Q28 70 36 72 Z' fill='#3fbf6e'/>
  <path d='M12 62 Q6 58 4 62 Q6 66 12 64 Z' fill='#8ef0b0'/>
  <!-- front leg (right, standing) -->
  <path d='M64 78 Q68 86 66 90 Q64 94 58 92 Q56 88 60 82 Z' fill='#4fd47e'/>
  <path d='M66 90 Q74 92 74 96 Q68 98 62 95 Z' fill='#8ef0b0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#3fbf6e'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#d4f7a8'/>
  <!-- raised arm (left) -->
  <path d='M28 54 Q18 44 20 34 Q22 28 28 32 Q32 38 30 46 Z' fill='#4fd47e'/>
  <path d='M20 34 Q14 28 18 24 Q24 24 24 30 Z' fill='#8ef0b0'/>
  <!-- other arm (right) -->
  <path d='M72 56 Q82 50 84 42 Q86 36 80 38 Q76 44 74 50 Z' fill='#4fd47e'/>
  <path d='M84 42 Q90 38 88 32 Q82 32 82 38 Z' fill='#8ef0b0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='24' ry='19' fill='#4fd47e'/>
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='19' r='11' fill='#4fd47e'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='19' r='11' fill='#4fd47e'/>
  <!-- eye whites -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='19' r='7' fill='#f2fff0'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='19' r='7' fill='#f2fff0'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='20' r='4' fill='#123322'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='20' r='4' fill='#123322'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='18' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='18' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 40 Q50 50 62 40' stroke='#1c5c38' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='36' r='4' fill='#ff9bb0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='36' r='4' fill='#ff9bb0'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <path d='M86 20 L86 30' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='31' r='3.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M10 26 L10 16' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='26' r='3.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
